formula: effectiveKnownAt = max(conservative DATE_ONLY boundary OR verified exact timestamp, document/metadata retrieval and verification, ingestion, mappingKnownAt, methodologyKnownAt, source/registry/policy/identity/contract/method knowledge and contract effectivity boundary, provider receipt/correction clocks when applicable, all required additional contract boundaries)
eligibility: effectiveKnownAt<=systemKnownAt<=decisionAsOf<=assessedAt; economic period and authority effectivity checked; candidate output binds all cutoffs by contentHash

missing verification, ingestion and additional required contract boundary evidence blocks
